name: Do I need to prime new drywall before painting?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to prime new drywall before painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is essential to prime new drywall before painting. New drywall and joint compound have different porosities, meaning they absorb paint at varying rates. Priming creates a uniform surface, ensuring consistent paint absorption and a smooth, even finish. Skipping this step can lead to a patchy appearance, visible seams, and requires more paint coats to achieve desired coverage, ultimately affecting the final look and durability of your paint job.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, priming new drywall is essential to create a uniform surface for consistent paint absorption and a smooth, even finish.
